plain_description.what: Rebuilds label-free trees with 10% and 20% of the data held out, with extra random seeds. It counts how many tree splits pass the certification test against a null, compared with the usual 30% held-out split. No calls.
plain_description.why: Checks whether an earlier finding (certified structure stops growing once enough data is on the training side) is robust to the seed.
plain_description.information: Decides whether the 30% held-out split should change. Result: the plateau replicates. About 13 to 14 certified splits at 10% and 20%, against about 10 at 30%, while the number of leaves keeps growing. The 30% split stays.
